Aircraft.name: Adder
Aircraft.Instructions:
Adder By: dots
AG1 - open/close canopy AG2 - drag chute AG3 - arresting hook AG4 - attitude hold mode (caution) AG7 - jettison weapons AG8 - toggle lights
Trim - trim (won't work in attitude hold mode)
Attitude hold mode: - Do NOT land with it enabled - Do NOT perform intentional stalls with it enabled
Notes: Fast and agile fighter jet. It should've had a backwards-tilted seat, but for reasons it got reverted back to the seat that has no tilt to it.
